ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The numbers 1 to 8 are written into the circles shown so that there is one number in each circle. Along each of the five straight arrows the three numbers in the circles are multiplied. Their product is written next to the tip of the arrow. How big is the sum of the numbers in the three circles on the lowest row of the diagram?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are 8 circles in total, arranged in three layers: the top row has 3 circles, the middle row has 2 circles, and the bottom row has 3 circles. There are 5 straight arrows in the figure, each arrow passes through 3 circles, and beside the arrow ends are labeled the products 30, 48, 105, 28, 144 respectively. Name them according to the method draft: the top row from left to right is A, B, C; the middle row from left to right is D, E; the bottom row from left to right is F, G, H. Reading from the arrows in the figure: A·B·C=30, B·D·F=48, C·E·G=105, A·D·G=28, B·E·H=144. Then reason: The circles are filled with 1 to 8 and are all different. A·D·G=28, because 28=1×4×7, so A, D, G are {1,4,7}. C·E·G=105, because 105=3×5×7, so C, E, G are {3,5,7}. The circle shared by the two triples is G, therefore G=7. Thus A, D are {1,4}, and C, E are {3,5}. From A·B·C=30, under the restrictions that A belongs to {1,4} and C belongs to {3,5}, the only possibility is A=1, C=5, B=6. Thus D=4, E=3. Then from B·D·F=48, F=48/(6×4)=2; from B·E·H=144, H=144/(6×3)=8. The three circles in the bottom row are F, G, H, namely 2, 7, 8, so the sum is 2+7+8=17.

Read the five arrow-products from the diagram as A·B·C=30, B·D·F=48, C·E·G=105, A·D·G=28, and B·E·H=144. From the text, the entries are the distinct numbers 1 through 8. Factor the restrictive products: A·D·G=28 must use {1,4,7}, and C·E·G=105 must use {3,5,7}, so the shared circle G is 7. Then A,D are {1,4} and C,E are {3,5}. Use A·B·C=30 to force A=1, C=5, B=6. Then D=4 and E=3. Finally compute F=48/(B·D)=48/(6·4)=2 and H=144/(B·E)=144/(6·3)=8. The lowest row sum is F+G+H=2+7+8=17.
